cards.title: Defensive Pre-Screening & Fast-Fail (Stages 1–2)
items: Stage 1 Quality Gate: OpenCV Laplacian variance tests image focus in <25ms; blurry photos (<100) trigger direct bypass to Stage 8 (RETAKE), skipping Stages 2–7
Stage 2 Forensic Authenticity: Error Level Analysis (ELA) and 4×4 grid noise check detect Photoshop airbrushing and tampered serial numbers

cards.title: Visual Intelligence, Swarm & Fusion (Stages 3–6)
items: Stage 3 Reference Match: 3072-dim embedding queries local FAISS in <15ms to retrieve matching Golden Blueprint
Stage 4 ROI Scheduler: Slices board into 12× magnified micro-crops to eliminate scale drift on 1mm components
Stage 5 Parallel Swarm: EasyOCR (serials), OpenCV NCC (logos), custom YOLO11n (8 hardware classes), and Multimodal VLM run concurrently
Stage 6 Evidence Fusion: Anomaly Max-Pooling (0.65 mean + 0.35 max override) prevents clean components from diluting defects

cards.title: AI Governance & Industrial Policy (Stages 7–8)
items: Stage 7 AI Forensic Judge: Groq LPU (gpt-oss-20b primary, <1.5s) writes plain-English root-cause summary with Gemini 2.5 Flash fallback
Stage 8 Policy Engine: Deterministically maps final anomaly score to industrial action: ACCEPT, RETAKE, QUARANTINE, or VENDOR_VERIFICATION
